sources.layer: OSM visual buildings/context and optional visual heights
sources.product: Zuid-Holland OSM extract; local visual layers and heights
sources.evidence_level: A: identified local PBF and export scripts
sources.known: A local Zuid-Holland .osm.pbf and separate export scripts for cartographic context and visual heights have been identified. The visual height join covers 4,791 of 221,324 scientific buildings (2.2%); others use a 12 m display fallback.
sources.modifications: Feature filtering/conversion; building:levels to approximately 3 m per level, optional height tags; schematic 12 m fallback where missing.
sources.obligations: Credit © OpenStreetMap contributors with licence link; examine vector/database redistribution obligations independently from display rights.
sources.open_action: Capture exact PBF download date, source hash, transformations and output-specific ODbL classification.

sources.product: AHN5 DTM 5 m original tiles and derived Rotterdam mosaic
sources.evidence_level: A/B: AHN5 documented; 28/28 source hashes agree with scanner inventory; provider licence confirmed
sources.known: The local AHN5 source document identifies the product, URLs and hashes for 28 original 5 m tiles; all match the scanned inventory. The RTM-05 audit confirms an original derived mosaic exists.
sources.modifications: 5 m mosaicking for terrain and browser Terrarium encoding. Approximately 70% of 3D tile pixels are nearest-valid-sample visual reconstruction, not measured AHN5 elevation/bathymetry.
sources.obligations: Credit AHN programme, provide CC BY 4.0 licence link, note transformations and the visual reconstruction; verify original file-level notices and attribution in published tile outputs.
sources.open_action: Link the exact published terrain assets/hashes to AHN5 source manifest and confirm required credit wording appears with the terrain display.
